mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant, bot_id, status, last_message_at, error_message, error_count, last_ping_at, updated_at FROM crm_wecom_aibot_connection ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tenant, bot_id, status, last_message_at, error_message, error_count, last_ping_at, updated_at FROM crm_wecom_aibot_connection WHERE tenant = #{tenant} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_aibot_connection (tenant, bot_id, status, last_message_at, error_message, error_count, last_ping_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{botId}, #{status}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{errorMessage}, #{errorCount}, #{lastPingAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant) DO UPDATE SET bot_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.bot_id, crm_wecom_aibot_connection.bot_id), status = EXCLUDED.status, last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at, error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message, error_count = EXCLUDED.error_count, last_ping_at = EXCLUDED.last_ping_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO crm_wecom_aibot_connection (tenant, bot_id, status, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{botId}, #{status}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant) DO UPDATE SET bot_id = EXCLUDED.bot_id, status = CASE WHEN crm_wecom_aibot_connection.status = 'disconnected' THEN EXCLUDED.status ELSE crm_wecom_aibot_connection.status END, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
